LanguageData.RatkinQL_PeddlerTree_Report: Traded with a ratkin peddler on the road.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_Greeting: A small ratkin traveller shrugs off a heavy pack and gives {Interviewer_labelShort} a once-over. "Oh — a proper settlement, all the way out here. I walk the long roads between the burrows. I've road-bread and a bottle or two to spare, if your larder's looking thin. What'll it be?"
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_OptNews: Ask what's happening out on the roads
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_OptHaggle: Haggle hard for a cut-rate deal — 25 silver (requires Social 7+)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_OptFair: Trade at a fair price — 40 silver
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_OptGenerous: Pay generously and see them off well — 60 silver
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_ReasonSocial: Your negotiator's Social skill is below 7.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_MsgGoods: The ratkin unpacks a stack of hardtack and a couple of bottles onto the ground, and tucks the silver away.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_MsgHaggle: The peddler counts the silver twice, ears flat. "...Fine. Fine. Highway robbery, is what it is." They won't forget being squeezed like that.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_MsgGenerous: The peddler blinks at the extra coin, then bows low. "May your burrow never flood. I'll tell the others you're good folk out here."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_News1: "The Kingdom's grain barges are running late this season — everyone's tightening their belts. Good time to be selling food, if you've got a surplus."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_News2: "They say the warlord's press-gangs are out again past the eastern ridge. If some ragged ratkin comes begging at your gate one night, well... you didn't hear it from me."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_News3: "The general store's caravans have been asking after this stretch of road. If they come knocking, deal square with them — that lot remembers a face."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Peddler_Farewell: The peddler swings the pack back up onto both shoulders. "Long road ahead. Mind how you go — and keep a light in the window for travellers."
LanguageData.RatkinQL_NotRatkin: Not one of the ratkin folk.
